label: Grenadier
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Squad throws EMP grenades. Vehicle movement and attack slow while the effect lasts.

label: M.S.V.
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Unarmed vehicle sets up near friendly vehicles and boosts their combat output and speed.

label: Shatterer
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Hover vehicle stuns infantry with a sonic attack. Airborne threats require allied support.

label: Slingshot
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Hover platform fires only at aircraft from up to two tiles away in the showcase.

label: Battering ram
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Four-legged ground vehicle can occupy rock formations and strikes structures by ramming.

label: Drone swarm
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Multi-aircraft scout with extended sight and an anti-infantry attack.

label: Mohawk gunship
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Aircraft specializes in ground vehicles. Anti-air infantry and aircraft can counter it.

label: Razorback
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Anti-infantry aircraft strafes with twin swiveling guns while moving.

label: Orca bomber
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Flies over ground targets to drop a payload. The center hex receives more damage than surrounding hexes.

label: Juggernaut
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Three-cannon walker alternates travel and stationary bombardment. Showcase identifies six affected tiles and three-tile firing distance, leaving a blind zone.

label: Fanatic
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Deaths of individual squad members increase nearby allies’ attack and movement speeds.

label: Scavenger
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Collects Tiberium when nearby friendly or enemy units die. Multiple nearby Scavenger squads receive separate rewards.

label: Mutant marauders
documented_mechanic_original_summary: High-health anti-vehicle infantry carry oversized scavenged emitters. They require other units to cover air.

label: Cyberwheel
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Fast ground scout squad. The loss of individual members reduces damage output.

label: Chem buggy
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Moves while spraying ground tiles. Lingering gas can be ignited by Jade’s power.

label: Giga-cannon
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Sustained beam ramps up and splits toward enemies adjacent to the target. Spread formations reduce secondary hits.

label: Laser drone
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Fast anti-vehicle air squad can contest a pad and harass an isolated harvester.

label: Catalyst gunship
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Air unit seeds a gas cloud and ignites the cloud. Its progress indicator sits on its back. The local explosion hits ground targets.

label: Shade
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Stealthed VTOL with directed fire and a separate adjacent-hex EMP effect.

label: Centurion
documented_mechanic_original_summary: Walker shield absorbs incoming damage, including an opening ranged shot. Positioning changes who gets the first effective hit.
